title: iberis lagascana var. granatensis
intro: Iberis lagascana var. granatensis, commonly known as Spanish rose or rockcress, is a flowering plant species in the Brassicaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, which include acting as an anti-inflammatory and antioxidant, helping to protect against cell damage and promoting overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Iberis lagascana var. granatensis include its ability to reduce inflammation, improve cardiovascular health, and support immune function. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
